# Exporting

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
#| eval: false
ggsave("plots/", width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 120)
ggsave("plots/", width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300) # Best practice dpi
ggsave("plots/", width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 600)

# Transparent background:
ggsave("plots/", width, height, bg = "transparent")
```
